title: Law 1 Probe: 64-Atom Noisy Zipf Hexagonal Codebook (P=96 != K=64)
intuition: Falsification probe testing whether discrete-atomic mechanisms generalize beyond exact zero-noise hypercubes: 64 hexagonal atoms with sigma/Delta=0.02 Gaussian jitter, 8:1 Zipf weights, and mismatched P=96 particles.
failure_mode: Exact zero-radius duplicate detectors fail to fire under 2% Gaussian jitter, while rigid 1-to-1 bijection ledgers flatten the 8:1 Zipf weights or misallocate the 32 surplus particles.
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence diagnostic probe (1,600 updates, K=64 atoms, P=96 particles).
